title: Actual bounded centered perturbation laws and finite canonical KL
source_anchor: Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, August 20 2026, Exercise 1.7/(1.E.1), printed43/PDF55; Corollary2.1.2, printed50/PDF62. Pinned source/topology retained in proof-obligations/chewi-exercise-1-7.
target_statement: For an a.e.-strongly-measurable uniformly a.e.-bounded centered real f on a probability space, sufficiently small real e gives an actual withDensity probability law with density at least 1/2 a.e.; its canonical ENNReal KL equals ofReal of the compensated entropy integral, hence is finite.
consumers: Chewi Exercise1.7 probability-KL expansion using the compiled compensated integral limit
Chewi Corollary2.1.2 explicit (1.E.1) reuse for bounded smooth compact-gradient tests
